name: Home Assistant Bot
tagline: Drives your Home Assistant lights, climate and routines, and onboards you first
description: A smart-home foreman for households running Home Assistant. Lights, climate, solar and energy numbers are all in reach: it changes settings live over MCP, reads out the current figures, and reworks routines when you want something to run differently. A new owner gets walked through the connection first.
author: DomenicoNicoli
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
